deadline_argument.meaning: deadline value passed to the Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager by increaseLiquidityCurrentRange

block_timestamp_at_call.meaning: block.timestamp value at the time the increaseLiquidityCurrentRange call is made

deadline_bounds_mining_time.meaning: the supplied deadline bounds when the transaction may be mined, i.e. the deadline is strictly greater than the block.timestamp at which the transaction is included so a pending transaction cannot be executed at an arbitrarily later time

mev_disadvantage_occurred.meaning: a malicious actor or MEV bot executed the delayed transaction at a disadvantage to the original submitter

assumptions: The deadline argument is the only time bound governing when the pending transaction may be mined.
The original submitter's transaction is pending and can be included by a later miner or MEV bot.

unresolved.description: The report states only a capability that delayed transactions could be executed at a disadvantage; it does not define the concrete disadvantage or value relation needed to bind mev_disadvantage_occurred to a numeric outcome.

limitations: The deadline-bounds-mining-time requirement is represented by a grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric bound beyond the equality of deadline and block.timestamp.
The exact disadvantage or value lost to the original submitter is not specified, so the impact is represented by a grounded Boolean occurrence symbol.
